entities.summary: Ângelo Monteiro dos Santos Victoriano was an Angolan basketball player. He was listed at 6 ft 6 in and 247 lbs.. Victoriano was inducted to the FIBA Basketball Hall of Fame in 2023 as the second Angolan player in history. Victoriano holds the record for most FIBA AfroBasket titles in history with eight titles, and in his club career in Angola he won eleven national championships and ten national cups.
